coverage:

The trainer's turning mask covers 86.6%, 85.9%, and 85.7% of frames, so it describes most of a clip.
The smallest train–validation Kolmogorov–Smirnov p-value across y span, vy scale, travel, signed displacement, |vy| fraction, x span, and vx scale is 0.00.
8 training clips, 3 validation clips, and 0 test clips stay inside the zero vy bin. Negative vx bins hold 0.30% of training frames, so the longitudinal label does not reverse.
